@Roth.Θ_equiv : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {τ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype τ] (e : σ ≃ τ) (B : ℝ)
  (q r : τ → ℕ), Roth.Θ B (q ∘ ⇑e) (r ∘ ⇑e) = Roth.Θ B q r

theorem Roth.Θ_equiv.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {τ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype τ] (e : σ ≃ τ)
  (B : ℝ) (q r : τ → ℕ), Roth.Θ B (q ∘ ⇑e) (r ∘ ⇑e) = Roth.Θ B q r :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {τ} [Fintype τ] e B q r ↦
  congrArg sSup
    (subset_antisymm (Roth.indexSet_comp_subset✝ e B q r)
      (id
        (Eq.mp
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg LE.le
              (congr (congrArg (Roth.indexSet B) (funext fun x ↦ congrArg q (Equiv.apply_symm_apply e x)))
                (funext fun x ↦ congrArg r (Equiv.apply_symm_apply e x))))
            (Roth.indexSet B (fun x ↦ q (e x)) fun x ↦ r (e x)))
          (Roth.indexSet_comp_subset✝ e.symm B (q ∘ ⇑e) (r ∘ ⇑e)))))

THETAEQUIV193_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {τ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype τ] (e : σ ≃ τ) (B : ℝ)
  (q r : τ → ℕ), Roth.Θ B (q ∘ ⇑e) (r ∘ ⇑e) = Roth.Θ B q r
